Pacific Global Investment Management Company increased its stake in Noble Corp Plc (NE) by 54.18% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pacific Global Investment Management Company who had been investing in Noble Corp Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.30 billion market cap company.
